task.title: Remove a service account from a group
task.shortdesc: The Organization Administrator can delete a service account from a User Access group on the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console. Any user can create a service account but only the Organization Administrator or a User Access administrator can delete service accounts from groups.

ul.li: Ensure you are logged in to the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console as an Organization Administrator or as a user with User Access administrator permissions.
Confirm one or more service accounts are associated with your Red Hat organization account.

step.cmd: From the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console, click the settings icon (⚙) and click User Access.
To delete the service account from a group, click the Groups tab and click the name of the group that includes the service account.
When the group name window appears, click the Service accounts tab. All service accounts in that group appear.

substep.cmd: Click the options icon (⋮) in the Name row and click Remove.
Acknowledge the Remove service account? message and click Remove service account.
Click the check box next to each account to remove.
Click the options icon (⋮) in any Name row of the selected service accounts and click Remove.
Acknowledge the Remove service account? message and click Remove service account.

step.cmd: Verify that the selected service account does not appear on the Service accounts tab.
